method: Binary floors read from every sampled Temurin/Zulu archive (first and last release of each major per vendor/os/arch, bisected to the exact release wherever the floor changed; Zulu series with non-monotonic floors scanned release by release). Windows: EXE subsystem version plus static imports of the core runtime files (java.exe, jvm.dll, java.dll, jli.dll, net/nio/zip/verify, bundled msvcr*/msvcp140/vcruntime140) checked against the Windows version that introduced each function (ReactOS export tables with -version tags, corrected from Microsoft Learn 'Minimum supported client'); delay-loaded and optional libraries (awt, sunmscapi) are reported in evidence but do not set min_os. macOS: highest LC_BUILD_VERSION / LC_VERSION_MIN_MACOSX minos of any Mach-O in the archive. Linux: highest GLIBC_x.y version needed by any ELF. JRE and JDK images of the same vendor build share floors (one of them was sampled per release). Installers (.msi/.pkg/.deb/.rpm) carry the same binaries; their own installer requirements are not modelled.
filters: Every rule is limited by variant (temurin-jre/jdk vs zulu-jre/jdk: their builds of the same Java version have different floors). Rules cover archives and installers alike (the same binaries).
musl: Alpine/musl builds (libc=musl in releases.json) are not covered: os_versions.json has no musl ids.
